body:
Ben Carter: kicking off the Lifecycle growth experiments sprint today. using this thread to pin owners + links so we don’t lose them in DMs 🙏

Ben Carter: Sprint brief (Confluence): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Lifecycle+Growth+Experiments+Sprint+Brief
Ben Carter: Working backlog (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lifecycle-growth-sprint-backlog
Ben Carter: Readout template (Drive): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1experiment-readout-template

Ben Carter: Owners (high-level):
- Email onboarding v2: me (Ben) + Soojin for messaging review + Tessa for template refresh
- Console nudges: Marissa (PM) + Dylan (eng lead) + Kenji/Tessa (design)
- Measurement: Paula + Logan/Mei (telemetry/datasets) + Allison/Sergio (dashboards)
- Retargeting: me + Tyler (ops/attribution) + Jordan (sales exclusions)

Ben Carter: Logistics:
- Weekly sprint sync: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT (invite coming)
- Office hours: Thu 2:00–2:45 PT (drop in for blockers)
- Weekly readout doc due Monday EOD (so we can share Tues AM)

Camila Reyes: +1. also: please keep guardrails front-and-center (deliverability, opt-out, and sales opp exclusions). if anything feels sketchy, escalate early rather than “ship and pray”.

Tyler Benson: thx. for attribution/UTMs, can we agree on a naming convention now so we don’t have to backfill later? I’ll draft but need sign-off.

Ben Carter: yes pls. add a short section to the sprint brief / or drop in here and I’ll pin. we should align before retargeting goes live.

Jordan Blake: re: retargeting exclusions — we need a clean suppression list for active opps + enterprise domains. I can provide rules + weekly refresh cadence. what’s the earliest you’d need it?

Ben Carter: earliest: Week 3 launch, but we should lock it by end of Week 2 so creative/targeting QA isn’t blocked.

Marissa Cole: for console nudges, Dylan + I are meeting after this to finalize placements + “completion” definitions. we’ll link the nudge framework doc once updated.

Dylan Brooks: yup. also reminder: feature flag targeting + holdout is in-flight. we can’t run a clean experiment without cohort assignment. Benji/Ethan are on it.

Paula Mendes: measurement: we should align on exact activation milestones:
1) signup
2) API key created
3) first successful request
4) first 100k tokens within 7 days
and TTFT for first request. I’ll sync with Nadia/Mei on event taxonomy + pipeline.

Soojin Lee: I’ll review copy for “latency/cost/reliability” emphasis and keep it consistent across email + console + landing pages. please @ me before anything goes to design so we don’t churn.

Tessa Morgan: design side: I can take email template refresh this week (mobile + spacing + brand). I’ll need final-ish copy blocks and CTA text by Wed noon PT.

Ben Carter: perfect. action items (quick):
- Tyler: drop proposed UTM convention here by tomorrow
- Jordan: send exclusion rules (even draft) by Fri
- Marissa/Dylan: link updated nudge framework + proposed first experiment by EOW
- Paula: share event spec / KPI definitions doc link when ready

Ben Carter: also here’s the Linear sprint plan ticket for status updates: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PM-642/lifecycle-growth-experiments-sprint-plan

Tyler Benson: got it. will propose `utm_campaign=lifecycle_activation_q1_2026` + `utm_source` by channel + `utm_content` for creative variant. open to tweaks.

Camila Reyes: works for me as a starting point. just make sure we can separate email vs console vs paid in reporting.

Ben Carter: 👍 thanks all. keep updates in the Linear ticket and link readouts in the Drive folder. I’ll post calendar invites shortly. :thumbsup:
